items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: He had Bobby Foster on the boat. Well, well, not, not, not then, when, when I was there.

ctx.x: The time you got on the boat where you, most of the people picked you up at the time?

Oh, well, well, when I was on the boat, I was, was moving pretty nicely, see. But then, I didn't know, I didn't know how to read very fast then, see. And, and fate used to take me and the bass player was with him. See, he had bass player with him. I was the second bass player. He had Bobby Foster on the boat. Well, well, not, not, not then, when, when I was there. The fellow was by the name of Cecil, Cecil Scott, his name was, or the St. Louis. Yeah. No, he was the one. He played, he played bass, he played flute,…
